question: ______ hosted the 2nd Olympic Games in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**France, 1900.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Second Olympic Games:- **

 
 
• **The second Olympic Games, officially known as the Games of the II Olympiad, were held in Paris, France, from May 20 to October 28, 1900. **
 
• The Games were held as part of the 1900 World's Fair, and were initially overshadowed by the Fair's attractions.
 
• However, they were eventually a success, with over 1,000 athletes from 24 nations competing in 20 sports.
 
• Some of the highlights of the 1900 Olympic Games:-
 
 
• The first women were allowed to compete in the Olympics, though only in a limited number of sports.
 
• The first time a marathon was run over the now-standard distance of 26.2 miles (42.2 kilometers).
 
• The first time that boxing was included in the Olympics.
 
• The first time that the United States won the most medals
